question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

Not fit for eating
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inedible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Inedible" **refers to something that is not suitable or safe to eat. (अखाद्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The food was so badly cooked that it was inedible.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the term for "Not fit for eating" is **'Inedible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inedible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inept **(अयोग्य): Lacking skill or ability.

 
 
• **Example:** His inept handling of the situation only made things worse.
 
 
 
• **Ineligible **(अनर्ह): Not qualified or suitable to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **He was ineligible to participate in the competition due to his age.
 
 
 
• **Ineluctable** (अपरिहार्य): Not to be avoided or escaped; inevitable.
 
 
• **Example:** The ineluctable conclusion of the argument was clear to everyone.
